note: Hand-written complaints in wording that does NOT appear in the supplied
history, used to estimate how intake behaves on the fresh scenarios
judges will type. Expected categories are the unambiguous reading of each
complaint against the supplied category master; where a complaint could
reasonably map to two categories, both are listed in 'acceptable'.
These are fixtures for evaluation only and are never loaded into the app.

complaints.text: The streetlight outside our lane has been dead for three weeks and children walk back from tuition in the dark.
Nobody has picked up the rubbish from our corner since last Tuesday and it is starting to smell.
After the rain the drain outside the school is completely choked and the water is standing.
We have had no water in our taps for four days now, the tanker also did not come.
The water coming from the tap is yellow and smells bad, my daughter fell ill after drinking it.
There is a huge crater in the middle of the road near the bus stand, two scooters have already fallen.
A live wire is hanging low over the footpath and sparking when it rains. Someone will be killed.
My caste certificate application has been pending at the office for over a month with no update.
The ration shop owner is refusing to give us our full quota and asking for extra money.
The roof of our village school classroom leaks and the children sit on wet floors.
My widow pension has not been credited for three months even though the papers were approved.
The canal water has not reached our fields this season and the crop is drying.
I want to report harassment by a man who follows me to work every day. Please keep my name confidential.
A child in our neighbourhood is being made to work at a shop instead of going to school.
The public toilet at the market has no water and is in a filthy unusable state.
Stray cattle have taken over the main junction and there is no one from the department to remove them.
Heavy rain last night flooded the lower colony and several houses are damaged.
The bus shelter roof has blown off and people stand in the sun waiting.
I have complained about this same blocked gutter four times and nothing has been done.
The park near our society has broken swings and the grass has not been cut in months.
